source: margaritavilleatsea.com official deck-plan PDF (Paradise) — visual transcription
sourceDetail: Cabin numbers transcribed by eye from the official Margaritaville at Sea 'Paradise DECK PLANS' single-page poster PDF (Mark's Google Drive: 'Margaritaville at sea/Paradise Deck Plan_2026-07-27'). The PDF is one 3456x2592 raster image with NO text layer; numbers read from 5x-upscaled per-deck crops. Ship is ex-Grand Classica / ex-Costa. Total 658 cross-checks against cruisemapper's advertised 656 staterooms.

notes.completeness: COMPLETE grid (658 staterooms) vs cruisemapper's advertised 656 — a 2-cabin difference (likely a counting nuance, e.g. accessible/crew rows), with ZERO duplicate numbers across all decks. Guest cabins occupy decks 4,5,6,7 (full) and deck 10 (10 Grand Terrace Suites 1001-1010). Decks 8 (Stars on the Water theater/lounges), 9 (Love and Luck casino/retail/dining), 11 (License to Chill spa/pools), 12 (Banana Wind sports), 14 (Nothin But a Breeze) carry no staterooms.
notes.category: The poster legend has 7 categories: Interior Stateroom 16/17/18 (three green shades), Ocean View Stateroom O4/O5 (two golds), Grand Terrace Suite S1 (salmon), Junior Suite S3 (purple). The three interior greens and two ocean-view golds are near-indistinguishable at poster resolution, so cabins are grouped to Interior / Ocean View / Grand Terrace Suite / Junior Suite. Outer hull columns = Ocean View, centre columns = Interior. The 16/17/18 and O4/O5 sub-classes were NOT reliably separable and are not asserted.
notes.section: DERIVED heuristic: forward/mid/aft by vertical position in the deck strip. Approximate.
notes.side: DERIVED, UNVALIDATED geometric guess: port = left outer column, starboard = right outer column (bow-up assumed). Centre interior columns are side=null. NOT validated against a known cabin; could be uniformly mirrored.
notes.obstructed: Not encoded by the source; obstructed=false for all.
notes.position: x/y/fill are null: source is a flat raster poster, not an SVG. fill carries the legend swatch colour for the category group.
